title: Ranger (Interstellar)
intro: The Ranger is a fictional winged shuttle from Christopher Nolan's film Interstellar (2014). It lands on planets and docks with the ring-shaped mothership Endurance. The two-seat flight deck has rows of switches and small screens, and the robot TARS can take over the flying.

areas.name: Windows
areas.text: The forward windows of the shuttle.

panels.name: Windows
panels.text: The small forward windows of the Ranger's flight deck.
panels.context: The pilot looks out through them for landing and docking.

controls.name: Forward windows
controls.text: Small windows at the front of the lander give the view forward.
controls.context: The small windows make the view narrow, so the screens help with landing and docking.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: Switches and small screens in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: Rows of switches, small screens and the docking controls.
panels.context: The pilot flies, lands and docks with the mothership from here.

controls.name: Switch rows
controls.text: Rows of toggle switches that look like those of older real spacecraft.
controls.context: The film does not explain each switch.

controls.name: Small screens
controls.text: Small screens show the flight data and the picture of a docking camera.
controls.context: The camera helps line up with the mothership during docking.

controls.name: Docking controls
controls.text: Controls used to match the spin of the Endurance before docking.
controls.context: In the film the pilot spins the shuttle to the same speed as the turning mothership to dock with it.

areas.name: Co-pilot seat
areas.text: The second seat beside the pilot.

panels.name: Co-pilot seat
panels.text: The second seat on the Ranger's flight deck.
panels.context: A second pilot or one of the robots can sit and fly here.

controls.name: Co-pilot seat
controls.text: The second seat. The robots TARS and CASE can fly the Ranger as well.
controls.context: In the film a robot takes the controls when needed, for example during a hard manoeuvre.

areas.name: Stick and thrust control
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Control stick
panels.text: The control stick at the pilot's seat in the Ranger.
panels.context: It steers the shuttle in space and in the air.

controls.name: Control stick
controls.text: Pushing the stick forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; moving it left or right rolls the shuttle.
controls.context: The Ranger flies like an aircraft in air and with thrusters in space.

panels.name: Thrust control
panels.text: The thrust lever at the pilot's left (the catalog's guess).
panels.context: It sets the main engine thrust.

controls.name: Thrust control
controls.text: This lever is taken as the control for the main engines' thrust.
controls.context: Its place at the pilot's left is the catalog's guess; the film does not show it clearly.
